Zindagi bhar gulam rehne se achha hai azaadi ke liye ladte hue marna.
Azaadi samman hai.
Aazadi sabse badi daulat hai.

Azaadi aatmanirbharta ka sabse bada phal hai.
Azaadi seemaheen hai.
Azaadi himmat par adharit ek system hai.
Khushi activity mein hai.
Khushi insaani vikas ka antim lakshya hai.
Joy neki ka apne aap milne wala inaam hai.
Duniya mein sirf ek hi joy hai – shuru karna.
Freedom thoughts aur trails ke beech ka space hai.
Khushi amrit hai.
Joy brahmand ka shant sangeet hai.
Joy khoobsurati par aane wali achanak pratikriya hai.
Khushi is baat ka saboot hai ki divya shakti hai.
Azadi mann ki shakti hai.
Bina kisi purpose ke wander karo, apni rooh dhoondo.
Khushi bojh hai.
Azadi woh nahi jo tum chaho.
Khushi pyar ke sath jeene ka adhyatmik anubhav hai.
Azaadi tum ho.
Azaadi vicharon ke beech ki jagah hai.
